checks.description: Experimental Raspberry Pi 5 device-profile conformance with the strict v1alpha1 schema.
Go package tests covering the provisioning profile, adapter, live acquisition, and CLI behavior.

Synthetic capsule-bound regular-file fixture validates FAT/GPT layout, staged extents, reopened readback, complete partition digests, dm-verity, and fail-closed tamper rejection without making hardware or enforcement claims.
Provisioning-probe NixOS module evaluation and its narrow USB access boundary.
Immutable metadata-only probe bundle and compiled digest-manifest integrity.
Pinned rpiboot host tool emits one bounded metadata object on stdout without creating a side file.
kaiba-provision package with pinned probe-tool, profile, schema, manifest, and bundle inputs.
